Requirements: To be admitted to the Aerospace Engineering major, an individual must satisfy the general entrance requirements of the University and the specific requirements of the College of Engineering. As an impacted program, admission criteria are higher. Freshmen are required to have a minimum 3.0 STEM GPA (calculated using math and science courses). Transfer students must complete the following major-specific requirements with a grade of 'C' or better: MATH 122 (Calculus I), MATH 123 (Calculus II), and PHYS 151 (Mechanics & Heat), and have a minimum 2.5 GPA in these courses.
Description: Aerospace engineers are concerned with the design, development, testing, and production of aircraft, spacecraft, and related systems. The undergraduate program in aerospace engineering is designed to prepare students for a wide range of careers in the aerospace industry or for further study in graduate school. The curriculum provides a strong foundation in the fundamental principles of engineering and science, and it emphasizes the application of these principles to the design and analysis of aerospace systems. Students take courses in aerodynamics, propulsion, structures, and flight mechanics, and they participate in a year-long capstone design project in which they apply their knowledge to a real-world engineering problem.
ProgramWebsiteURL: The official university website for California State University, Long Beach is [www.csulb.edu](https://www.csulb.edu).
Accredidation: The Bachelor of Science in Aerospace Engineering program is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, https://www.abet.org, under the General Criteria and the Program Criteria for Aerospace and Similarly Named Engineering Programs.

ProgramName: Minor in Aerospace Engineering
Requirements: To be eligible for the aerospace engineering minor, a student must be in good academic standing and have completed the following prerequisite courses with a grade of 'C' or better: MATH 122, MATH 123, PHYS 151, and MAE 271 (or equivalents). The minor requires a minimum of 21 units. Students must apply to the Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering department for admission to the minor. To be awarded the minor, a student must maintain a 2.0 GPA in all courses taken for the minor.
Description: The Aerospace Engineering program provides a quality education to students in all major areas of Aerospace Engineering. The program objectives are to: provide students with a solid foundation in the fundamental principles of mathematics, science, and engineering; and to develop their ability to analyze and design aerospace systems. The minor in Aerospace Engineering is available to any CSULB student. To be eligible to enroll in the program, a student must have completed the lower-division requirements for a major in engineering, or have the approval of the Department Chair.
ProgramWebsiteURL: The official university website for California State University, Long Beach is [www.csulb.edu](https://www.csulb.edu).

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Biomedical Engineering
Requirements: To be considered for admission to the Bachelor of Science in Biomedical Engineering, applicants must meet the general California State University (CSU) admission requirements. As an impacted major, specific criteria are applied. Freshman applicants are evaluated based on their high school GPA and completion of 'a-g' courses. Transfer applicants must have completed a minimum of 60 transferable semester units, including major preparation courses: Calculus I (MATH 122), Calculus II (MATH 123), General Chemistry (CHEM 111A), and Calculus-based Physics (PHYS 151) with a minimum grade of 'C' in each course and a minimum cumulative GPA (typically 2.5 or higher).
Description: Biomedical Engineering is the application of engineering principles and design concepts to medicine and biology for healthcare purposes (e.g. diagnostic or therapeutic). This field seeks to close the gap between engineering and medicine, combining the design and problem-solving skills of engineering with medical biological sciences to advance health care treatment, including diagnosis, monitoring, and therapy. The Bachelor of Science in Biomedical Engineering program at CSULB provides students with a strong foundation in engineering, biology, and medicine. The curriculum is designed to prepare students for careers in the biomedical industry or for further study in graduate or professional schools. Students gain hands-on experience through laboratory courses and senior design projects, working on real-world problems in the field.
ProgramWebsiteURL: The official university website for California State University, Long Beach is [www.csulb.edu](https://www.csulb.edu).
Accredidation: The Bachelor of Science in Biomedical Engineering program is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, https://www.abet.org, under the commission’s General Criteria and Program Criteria for Bioengineering and Biomedical and Similarly Named Engineering Programs.

ProgramName: Minor in Biomedical Engineering
Requirements: To declare the BME minor, students must: 1. Have a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.5. 2. Complete MATH 122 (Calculus I) with a grade of 'C' or better. 3. Meet with the BME Minor Advisor.
Description: The Minor in Biomedical Engineering provides an opportunity for students to expand their knowledge in the fields of engineering, biology, and medicine. This minor is open to all students majoring in engineering or science who have completed the necessary prerequisites.
ProgramWebsiteURL: The official university website for California State University, Long Beach is [www.csulb.edu](https://www.csulb.edu).

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering
Requirements: To be considered for admission to the Chemical Engineering major as a first-time freshman, applicants must meet the following minimum requirements: A minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher. Applicants must be prepared to take Calculus (MATH 122) as evidenced by the Math Placement Category. Transfer applicants must complete the following major preparation courses with a grade of 'C' or better: CHEM 111A (General Chemistry), MATH 122 (Calculus I), MATH 123 (Calculus II), and PHYS 151 (Mechanics & Heat).
Description: Chemical engineering is a profession that is based on the application of the principles of the mathematical, physical and life sciences, and economics to the processes by which materials and energy are changed in form or composition for the benefit of humankind. The program is designed to provide a solid foundation in the engineering sciences and the fundamentals of chemical engineering. The curriculum includes courses in transport phenomena, thermodynamics, kinetics, process control, and plant design.
ProgramWebsiteURL: The official university website for California State University, Long Beach is [www.csulb.edu](https://www.csulb.edu).
Accredidation: Accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, http://www.abet.org.

ProgramName: Minor in Chemical Engineering
Requirements: To be eligible for the minor in chemical engineering, a student must be a declared major in a department other than Chemical Engineering and have a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.5. To be awarded the minor, a student must complete the following units with a minimum grade of "C" in each course: PHYS 151 - Mechanics and Heat, CHEM 111A - General Chemistry, CHEM 111B - General Chemistry, CH E 200 - Chemical Engineering Fundamentals, CH E 210 - Computer Methods in Chemical Engineering, CH E 220 - Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics I, CH E 310 - Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics II, CH E 420 - Chemical Engineering Reactor Design. In addition, one upper-division CH E elective course (minimum 3 units) is required.
Description: The Minor in Chemical Engineering is designed for students in related fields (such as chemistry or other engineering disciplines) to gain a basic understanding of chemical engineering principles. The minor provides a foundation in chemical process calculations, thermodynamics, transport phenomena, and chemical reactor design.
ProgramWebsiteURL: The official university website for California State University, Long Beach is [www.csulb.edu](https://www.csulb.edu).

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering
Requirements: Admission to the Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering is based on major-specific admission criteria. Freshmen applicants are evaluated based on a Multi-Factor Admission Criteria (MFAC) that primarily considers high school GPA. Transfer applicants must have completed a minimum of 60 transferable semester units and must complete the following major-specific prerequisite courses with a grade of 'C' or better: Calculus I (MATH 122), Calculus II (MATH 123), General Physics (PHYS 151), and General Chemistry (CHEM 111A).
Description: Civil Engineering is the professional art of applying the principles of the mathematical and physical sciences to the design and economical construction of structures and facilities for the use of society. The curriculum is designed to give the student a broad knowledge of the liberal arts and a strong background in the basic sciences and mathematics. It provides a thorough foundation in the traditional areas of civil engineering: environmental, geotechnical, structural, transportation, and water resources engineering.
ProgramWebsiteURL: The official university website for California State University, Long Beach is [www.csulb.edu](https://www.csulb.edu).
Accredidation: The Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering degree program is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, https://www.abet.org, under the General Criteria and the Civil and Similarly Named Engineering Programs Program Criteria.

ProgramName: Minor in Civil Engineering
Requirements: To be eligible for the Minor in Civil Engineering, a student must be in a major other than Civil Engineering. A minimum GPA of 2.5 is required in the following courses: MATH 122, MATH 123, PHYS 151, and CE 205. All courses for the minor must be completed with a grade of 'C' or better.
Description: The minor in Civil Engineering is available to any student at CSULB. The minor is designed to provide students with a basic understanding of the civil engineering profession. The minor is not intended to provide the necessary depth and breadth to practice civil engineering.
ProgramWebsiteURL: The official university website for California State University, Long Beach is [www.csulb.edu](https://www.csulb.edu).

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering
Requirements: To be admitted to the Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering, applicants must meet the general California State University (CSU) admission requirements. For freshmen, this includes completion of the 'A-G' college preparatory sequence and a qualifying GPA. For transfer students, requirements include the completion of 60 transferable semester units, the 'Golden Four' General Education courses, and specific major preparation coursework including MATH 122 (Calculus I), MATH 123 (Calculus II), and PHYS 151 (Mechanics and Heat) with a grade of 'C' or better.
Description: The Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering program is designed to provide students with a strong background in both hardware and software aspects of computer systems. Students must meet with the CECS department advisor to apply for the minor.
Description: The Minor in Computer Engineering is available to any CSULB student (except Computer Engineering majors). ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

For freshmen, admission is based on the CSU eligibility index which considers high school GPA and completion of 'a-g' courses.
Description: The Bachelor of Science in Computer Science degree program is designed to provide students with a strong theoretical and practical foundation in computer science. The curriculum includes a core of computer science courses that cover topics such as programming languages, data structures, algorithms, computer organization, operating systems, and software engineering. In addition, students are required to take courses in mathematics and science, as well as a range of elective courses in areas such as artificial intelligence, computer graphics, database systems, networks, and security. The program is designed to prepare students for careers in the computer industry, as well as for graduate study in computer science or related fields.

Requirements: To declare a minor in Computer Science, students must have completed CECS 174 with a grade of 'C' or better and have a 2.5 or higher GPA in all courses required for the minor. Description: The computer science minor is for students who want to develop their programming skills and knowledge of computer science without completing a full degree. This minor is available to any non-Computer Science major.
ProgramWebsiteURL: The official university website for California State University, Long Beach is [www.csulb.edu](https://www.csulb.edu).

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Construction Management
Requirements: To be admitted to the Construction Management major, an individual must meet the University's general admission requirements. Description: The Bachelor of Science in Construction Management degree program at CSULB is designed to prepare students for professional careers in the construction industry. The program provides a broad-based education in construction engineering and management, including courses in construction methods, materials, equipment, management, safety, and law. Students gain the technical and management skills necessary to effectively plan and manage construction projects from inception to completion.
ProgramWebsiteURL: The official university website for California State University, Long Beach is [www.csulb.edu](https://www.csulb.edu).

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering
Requirements: To be admitted to the Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, freshman applicants must meet the CSU minimum eligibility requirements and are ranked based on a STEM Index (calculated from high school GPA and math/science grades). Transfer students must complete the following major-specific requirements with a grade of 'C' or better: Calculus I (MATH 122), Calculus II (MATH 123), Calculus III (MATH 224) or Differential Equations (MATH 370), and Physics for Science and Engineering: Mechanics and Heat (PHYS 151).
Description: The Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering (B.S.E.E.) program at CSULB is designed to provide students with a solid foundation in the mathematical, scientific, and engineering principles necessary for a successful career in the field of electrical engineering. The program emphasizes both theoretical knowledge and practical skills, with a focus on areas such as electronics, signals and systems, control systems, communications, and power systems. Students have the opportunity to engage in hands-on laboratory experiences and design projects, and are encouraged to participate in internships and research activities.
Accredidation: The Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering program is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, http://www.abet.org, under the General Criteria and the Program Criteria for Electrical, Computer, Communications, Telecommunication(s) and Similarly Named Engineering Programs.

ProgramName: Minor in Electrical Engineering
Requirements: To be eligible for the Minor in Electrical Engineering, a student must be a current CSULB student and have a declared major in a department other than Electrical Engineering. Admission to the minor is by application through the Department of Electrical Engineering.

Description: The Bachelor of Science in Engineering Technology (BSET) degree at California State University, Long Beach, is a program that provides a broad-based, technically oriented education. ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering Technology

Transfer students must also complete specific major preparation courses, including mathematics (Calculus) and science (Physics) prerequisites, as specified by the department and the university's transfer major requirements.

ProgramWebsiteURL: The official university website for California State University, Long Beach is [www.csulb.edu](https://www.csulb.edu).

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Electronics Engineering Technology

Accredidation: The Bachelor of Science in Electronics Engineering Technology is accredited by the Engineering Technology Accreditation Commission (ETAC) of ABET.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering

Description: Mechanical engineering is one of the most diverse and versatile engineering disciplines. Mechanical engineers work in many industries including aerospace, automotive, biomedical, chemical, construction, electronics, energy, and manufacturing. The Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering degree program is designed to provide students with a strong foundation in mathematics, physics, and engineering sciences, followed by advanced courses in thermal sciences, mechanical systems, and manufacturing.
ProgramWebsiteURL: The official university website for California State University, Long Beach is [www.csulb.edu](https://www.csulb.edu).
